bulk_physics.policy: Later-screen planetary data exists; baseline playable profile keeps only stable broad facts unless exact astronomy becomes gameplay-relevant.

region_refs: lakes/falls only when mission/source resolves location
temporal_rules: Federation membership is political state separate from physical world.
Any Dominion occupation/control event is applied only if already in retained history at campaign start or produced by campaign events.
Telepathic culture does not expose World Truth.
ai_boundary: AI cannot reveal residents' private thoughts globally.
Do not infer all Betazoids have equal telepathic ability.
Do not invent noble/House status from cultural references.
visual_nap: lush attractive world without generic paradise exaggeration
Betazoid civic/house architecture needs specific references
telepathy has no automatic visual glow
unknowns: exact political institutions beyond known government context
